decks.notes: The deck focuses on using efficient creatures and removal spells to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. It also utilizes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Static Prison to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck's win conditions include powerful creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Emperor of Bones, as well as burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment. The mana base is fine-tuned to support the aggressive strategy, with a mix of fetch lands, shock lands, and utility lands to ensure consistent access to the right colors of mana.

The main strategy of this deck is to utilize Amulet of Vigor along with bounce lands like Simic Growth Chamber to generate mana and quickly ramp into Primeval Titan. With Primeval Titan's ability to search for utility lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Gruul Turf, this deck aims to assemble powerful land combinations to overwhelm the opponent and win the game through various win conditions such as Valakut triggers or creating massive token armies. The deck also includes cards like Summoner's Pact and Green Sun's Zenith to search for key combo pieces and ensure consistency in executing the game plan.

This deck focuses on using the Underworld Breach combo to mill cards from the opponent's library and win the game through alternative win conditions such as Thassa's Oracle. It also utilizes cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to recur important combo pieces and control the game. Grinding Station and Malevolent Rumble are key components in the combo, along with Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal to generate mana and draw cards. The deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a win.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly mill your opponent's library using cards like Hedron Crab, Ruin Crab, and Fractured Sanity, while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Field of Ruin, Drown in the Loch, and Fatal Push. Tasha's Hideous Laughter and Archive Trap are used to mill large chunks of their library at once, potentially winning the game on the spot. The deck is designed to control the board and disrupt your opponent's strategy while whittling down their library to zero cards, winning the game through mill rather than traditional combat.

The deck focuses on using Underworld Breach and Grinding Station to combo off by recurring artifacts from the graveyard and milling the opponent's entire deck. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mishra's Bauble provide additional ways to put artifacts in the graveyard, while Urza's Saga helps to tutor for key combo pieces. The deck also includes some disruption and card selection tools like Teferi, Time Raveler and Preordain to help control the game until the combo can be assembled. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and win the game in a single turn.

The main idea of this Death and Taxes Aggro deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with efficient creatures. By utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Aether Vial, you can abuse enter-the-battlefield triggers and generate card advantage. With a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and creatures that disrupt the opponent's resources like Tidehollow Sculler, you can slow down your opponent's progress while building your board presence. The deck aims to control the tempo of the game and win through a combination of disruptive elements and aggressive creatures.

This deck focuses on ramping up quickly using Eldrazi creatures and ramp spells to quickly cast powerful threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. It utilizes control elements like Kozilek's Return and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also having access to Ancient Stirrings to help find key pieces of the deck. The deck also includes some land destruction elements with Wastescape Battlemage and Sowing Mycospawn to further disrupt the opponent's resources. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats and control elements.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with Eldrazi Temple and Utopia Sprawl to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. It also includes control elements like Kozliek's Command and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck utilizes Ancient Stirrings and Devourer of Destiny to help with card advantage and consistency. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with big, impactful creatures while controlling the board and staying ahead in terms of mana advantage.

This deck focuses on utilizing blink effects to repeatedly trigger enter the battlefield abilities of creatures, allowing for aggressive plays and strong synergies. By using cards like Ephemerate and Aether Vial, players can constantly flicker creatures like Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Skyclave Apparition to disrupt the opponent's board and keep pressure on them. The deck also includes a mix of creatures with powerful abilities, such as Witch Enchanter and Overlord of the Balemurk, to create a versatile game plan that can adapt to different matchups.

This Landless Combo deck focuses on utilizing artifacts and counterspells to quickly assemble a powerful win condition, Goblin Charbelcher. By using cards like Whir of Invention and Lotus Bloom to ramp up mana, and Disrupting Shoal and Spell Snare to protect the combo pieces, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while setting up a game-winning Charbelcher activation. With additional control elements like Jwari Disruption and Suppression Ray, the deck aims to outmaneuver opponents and secure victory through its explosive combo potential.

The deck relies on cycling creatures like Street Wraith and Windcaller Aven to fill the graveyard quickly, then casting Living End to return all of those creatures to the battlefield while wiping the opponent's board. The deck also includes cards like Endurance and Subtlety to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Shardless Agent and Generous Ent allow for card advantage and Boseiju, Who Endures can protect key spells from counters. The goal is to set up a powerful board state while disrupting the opponent's strategy and winning the game with overwhelming creatures.

This deck focuses on utilizing efficient creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggression. It combines creatures with strong enter-the-battlefield effects like Skyclave Apparition and Ranger-Captain of Eos with powerful removal spells like Solitude to control the board while continuing the aggressive push. The deck also includes cards like Ephemerate and Eternal Witness to recur key cards and generate value. By maintaining a balance between aggression and control, this Selesnya Aggro deck aims to dominate the battlefield and secure victory in a fast-paced Modern 1 vs 1 matchup.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures and using burn spells to control the board and deal direct damage to the opponent. It also includes cards that provide additional benefits for attacking, such as creating tokens or gaining life. The strategy is to apply constant pressure on the opponent, utilizing a mix of creatures, burn spells, and powerful enchantments to overwhelm them quickly and efficiently.

The deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to constantly recur artifacts from the graveyard, enabling a powerful combo with Grinding Station and Thassa's Oracle to win the game. The deck also includes various cheap artifacts and mana sources to enable the combo quickly, along with disruption elements like Malevolent Rumble and Unholy Heat to control the opponent's board. With the ability to quickly assemble the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent, the deck aims to win the game efficiently in the early turns.

The main concept of this deck is to control the tempo of the game by disrupting opponents' strategies with counterspells and removal spells while building card advantage through card draw and graveyard interaction. The deck aims to protect its threats like Murktide Regent and Abhorrent Oculus while using cards like Psychic Frog and Thought Scour to disrupt the opponent's hand and graveyard. The deck also utilizes bounce effects like Brazen Borrower and Harbinger of the Seas to further disrupt the opponent's board state. Overall, the deck focuses on controlling the game and outmaneuvering opponents to secure victory.

This deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's strategy while generating card advantage through various means such as countering spells, removing threats from the board, and inducing your opponent to discard cards. It also includes powerful creatures like Murktide Regent to close out the game once your opponent's resources have been depleted. The deck aims to control the game until it can establish a dominant position and ultimately win through attrition and efficient use of resources.
